lead: The options are different forms of one pronoun: she, her, hers, herself, or its, it's, their, theirs. The job the word does in the sentence decides the form.
選項是同一個代名詞的不同格，例如 she、her、hers、herself，或 its、it's、their、theirs。這個字在句中的功能決定答案。
steps: Ask what the blank does: subject, object, owner before a noun, or an owned thing standing alone.
判斷空格的功能：主詞、受詞、名詞前的所有格，還是單獨使用、代表某人的東西。
Find who or what it points to, and check singular or plural, person or company.
找出它指的是誰或什麼，確認單複數，是人還是公司。
If the subject and the object are the same person, think of the reflexive form.
如果主詞和受詞是同一個人，想到反身代名詞。

head: Four forms
四種格
body: Subject form (she) does the action. Object form (her) follows a verb or preposition. Possessive (her) goes before a noun. Possessive pronoun (hers) stands alone and means her plus a noun.
主格（she）做動作；受格（her）接在動詞或介系詞後；所有格（her）放在名詞前；所有代名詞（hers）單獨使用，等於 her 加名詞。
ex: Mr. Wong asked us to contact him directly.
黃先生請我們直接聯絡他。
Please submit your expense report by Friday.
請在星期五前提交你的費用報告。
This laptop is mine, and that one is hers.
這台筆電是我的，那台是她的。

head: Reflexive: herself, themselves
反身代名詞
body: Use it when the subject and the object are the same person. At the end of a clause it stresses that the person did it personally. By oneself means alone.
主詞和受詞是同一人時使用。放在句尾強調是本人親自做的。by oneself 表示獨自。
ex: New staff should familiarize themselves with the safety rules.
新進員工應熟悉安全規定。
Ms. Lopez designed the entire website herself.
Lopez 女士親自設計了整個網站。
The interns organized the event by themselves.
實習生們獨自籌辦了這場活動。

head: Its and it's
its 與 it's
body: Its shows ownership. It's means it is or it has. A company is usually singular, so it takes it and its.
its 是所有格（它的），it's 是 it is 或 it has。公司通常視為單數，用 it 和 its。
ex: The company announced its quarterly results on Monday.
公司在星期一公布了季度成果。
It's too early to confirm the schedule.
現在要確認時程還太早。

head: That of and those of
that of 與 those of
body: In a comparison, that of and those of stand in for a noun already mentioned, so it is not repeated. That replaces a singular noun, those a plural one.
比較句裡，that of、those of 代替前面出現過的名詞，避免重複。單數用 that，複數用 those。
ex: Our prices are lower than those of our competitors.
我們的價格比競爭對手低。
The climate in the south is milder than that of the north.
南部的氣候比北部溫和。

head: Another, other, others
another、other、others 的差別
body: Another + singular noun means one more. Other + plural noun means more of them. Others stands alone for other people or things. The others means all the rest.
another + 單數名詞是「另一個」；other + 複數名詞；others 單獨使用，指其他的人或東西；the others 指剩下的全部。
ex: Some employees prefer to work from home; others prefer the office.
有些員工喜歡在家工作，其他人喜歡辦公室。
If this room is not available, we can use another one.
如果這間會議室不能用，我們可以用另一間。

head: Each other, one another, neither
each other、one another、neither 的用法
body: Each other and one another mean the action goes both ways, and either can be used. Neither means not the one and not the other, and takes a singular verb.
each other 和 one another 表示動作是互相的，通常兩者皆可。neither 表示兩者都不，用單數動詞。
ex: Team members are encouraged to support one another.
鼓勵團隊成員互相支援。
Two vendors sent quotes, and neither was within budget.
有兩家廠商寄來報價，但都不在預算內。

why: Its is the possessive. It's means it is.
its 才是所有格。it's 是 it is。

pairs.right: She finished the report by herself.
pairs.wrong: She finished the report by her.
why: By oneself means alone, so it needs the reflexive form.
by oneself 表示獨自，要用反身代名詞。

pairs.right: Our rates are lower than those of other banks.
pairs.wrong: Our rates are lower than them of other banks.
why: The word stands in for the plural noun rates, so it is those.
這個字代替前面的複數名詞 rates，要用 those。

traps: A blank with no noun after it, meaning something that belongs to someone, takes mine, yours, hers, ours or theirs. If a noun follows, use my, your, her, our or their.
空格後面沒有名詞、表示某人的東西時，用 mine、yours、hers、ours、theirs。後面有名詞就用 my、your、her、our、their。
Her has two jobs: object and possessive. A noun after it means possessive. If it ends the phrase after a verb or preposition, it is the object.
her 有兩種功能：受格和所有格。後面有名詞就是所有格；接在動詞或介系詞後面結束片語，就是受格。
In a Part 6 passage, look back for what the pronoun points to: a company (it, its), a group (they, their) or one woman (she, her).
Part 6 的代名詞題要往前找它指的是誰：公司（it、its）、一群人（they、their），還是一位女士（she、her）。
